svg.text: AI-assisted hostel complaint desk | Logical architecture for the hackathon MVP
Technology-neutral design: database, object storage and hosting provider are implementation choices.
Submit photo + one-line note; track own complaint
Review AI suggestions; approve, edit or close
See only assigned tasks; mark work done + note
Student complaint form + status | Warden queue + approval + digest | Worker task list + completion
Suggested REST actions: POST /complaints · GET /complaints · PATCH /complaints/{id}/review · PATCH /tasks/{id}/status · GET /alerts · GET /digest
Call the server-side Gemini API adapter
Worker updates status and completion note
Detect repeated issues by block + type
Use complaint/task data; no student scoring
Assignments · status history · repeat alerts · digest
Do not expose public image URLs
Input: photo + short Hindi / English / Hinglish note
Student: own complaints · Worker: assigned tasks · Warden: full queue
Validate uploads and note; accept only expected fields/categories
Demo/fake data only; keep API keys server-side and out of Git
AI recommends; the Warden makes the final task decision
and marks it done with note
MVP scope: web screens for student, warden and worker; photo-to-complaint AI; warden approval; assigned tasks; repeat alerts; daily digest.
Implementation note: FastAPI / React / PostgreSQL are possible choices, not requirements specified in the project overview.
